name: minidex-agent
description: Autonomous token orchestration system with MiniDEX, libp2p agents, PQC, and IPLD.

scripts.agents: concurrently "npm run deploy" "npm run monitor" "npm run report" "npm run liquidity" "npm run analytics"
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:agents && npm run test:security && npm run test:unit && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:network
scripts.test:contracts: hardhat test test/MiniDEX.test.js test/Security.test.js test/TokenA.test.js test/TokenB.test.js test/FrontendABI.test.js test/IgnitionDeployment.test.js
scripts.test:agents: hardhat test test/IPLD.test.js test/PQC.test.js test/NetworkDeliveryValidation.test.js test/DeliveryPolicy.test.js test/AgentWorkflow.test.js test/MessageDispatch.test.js test/TaskScheduler.test.js test/StructuredLogging.test.js test/HealthMonitoring.test.js test/Metrics.test.js test/RuntimeMetrics.test.js test/RateLimit.test.js test/Retry.test.js test/RuntimeConfig.test.js
scripts.test:security: hardhat test test/SecretManagement.test.js test/SecurityValidation.test.js test/MessageAuthentication.test.js test/AuthMiddleware.test.js test/TopicSchema.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run check:secrets && npm test && npm run build
